newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema trading heavy on Barron's mention.
newsitem.headline: Bema trading heavy on Barron's mention.

text.p: Trading in Bema Gold Corp was busy again on Monday, making gains after a write-up in the weekly publication Barron's.

The stock was up C$0.65 to C$10.75 in trading of more than 1.1 million shares after an analyst told Barron's that the stock looks slightly overvalued right now but that the company could be sitting on a 30-million ounce deposit in Chile.
Trading in Bema has been hectic since the company released drilling results from its Cerro Casale gold project in Chile last month.
While trading has been heavy, the stock price has been volatile as investors anticipate further drilling results from the property, analysts said.
